metadata.description: Agent skills for specwarden — one plugin per package.

plugins.name: specwarden
plugins.description: specwarden — A repository declares its rules; specwarden proves which hold.

plugins.name: specwarden-docs
plugins.description: @specwarden/docs — Documentation checks: paths, symbols, counts, placement, hygiene.

plugins.name: specwarden-plans
plugins.description: @specwarden/plans — Plans and decision logs — one way of working, not the only one.

plugins.name: specwarden-ops
plugins.description: @specwarden/ops — Env files, proxy upstreams, CI coverage, build order, shell scoping.

plugins.name: specwarden-security
plugins.description: @specwarden/security — Credential scanning, with a vendor library as a preset rather than a mandate.

plugins.name: specwarden-openspec
plugins.description: @specwarden/openspec — Reads an OpenSpec tree as the source of requirements.

plugins.name: specwarden-speckit
plugins.description: @specwarden/speckit — Reads a Spec Kit tree as the source of requirements.

plugins.name: specwarden-nestjs
plugins.description: @specwarden/plugin-nestjs — NestJS conventions, declared against the engine's primitives.
